newsitem.title: CANADA: Sears Canada plans C$300 mln store upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Sears Canada plans C$300 mln store upgrade.

text.p: Sears Canada Inc said on Monday that it plans a three-year, C$300 million upgrade of its mall-based department stores, including a $60 million revitalization of its Toronto stores in 1997.
"We decided to accelerate our capital investment in our mall stores in 1997," Sears Canada Chief Executive Paul Walters told the annual meeting.
"We selected the greater Toronto market as the first leg of a three-year, C$300 million capital program to revitalize and substantially reposition our malls-based department stores," Walters said.
Sears Canada said the plan included the expansion of 13 of its Toronto stores. Sears Canada is 61.1 percent-owned by Sears, Roebuck and Co.
